# Dilemma v3.0.1

- Rename the Polish quiz-closing button to `Zakończ quiz`. Other translations and quiz behavior remain unchanged.
- Update README guidance for timezones instead of the removed defaults command, up to three profile badges and event-driven scoring.

Upgrading from v3.0.0 requires no database migration or Discord command re-registration. The new label applies to newly created quiz controls; existing Discord messages retain their current label until their controls are updated.
